tiers.name: Foundation
tiers.tagline: Focused coaching for one clear goal
tiers.summary: For clients who want structure, accountability, and an integrated lens without broad active work across every domain

tiers.name: Integrated
tiers.tagline: Whole-context coaching for serious integrated change
tiers.summary: For clients who want meaningful coaching across body, intellect, and spirit

tiers.name: Intensive
tiers.tagline: Weekly live support for complex or demanding seasons
tiers.summary: For clients who need weekly live contact, priority written support, closer troubleshooting, and higher-touch implementation support

shared_includes.heading: Included in every tier
shared_includes.summary: Every coaching package uses the same integrated coaching model. The differences are active scope, live coaching cadence, complexity, and support depth.
items: Weekly progress review and feedback as frequently as once per week, including substantive evaluation, recommendations, and appropriate plan adjustments related to your coaching work
Ad hoc written support for clarification and troubleshooting related to your coaching work
Referral or tandem support when a need belongs with a licensed professional

cells.intensive: 4 x 60-minute sessions/month or equivalent scheduled live time

cells.foundation: One primary focus at a time, considered through an integrated lens
cells.integrated: Broader integrated coaching across the major areas affecting your goals
cells.intensive: Integrated coaching for complex goals, demanding seasons, or higher implementation friction

cells.foundation: Focused plan or program tied to the primary focus, with practices, assignments, and supporting recommendations as relevant
cells.integrated: Integrated plan or program across the relevant domains affecting your goals, with practices and assignments as needed
cells.intensive: Higher-touch implementation plan or program with more active prioritization, troubleshooting, and course correction across relevant domains

rows.label: Ad hoc written support response norm

cells.intensive: Priority response, sooner than 48 hours when feasible

cells.integrated: Possible by arrangement and quoted separately
cells.intensive: Possible by arrangement; substantial local or hybrid support may require Custom
